chunks: "Journeys should not be undertaken except to three mosques: al-Masjid al-Haram, the mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and the mosque of al-Kufah."

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, meaning Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ: Journeys are undertaken or mounts are prepared for travel
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ: Three mosques distinguished in this report
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ: The mosque of Kufah, a uniquely meritorious mosque in Shia tradition
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in al-Madinah

ai.seo_question: Which mosques are singled out for undertaking a journey in this hadith of Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام states that travel for special devotional visitation is restricted to three mosques of unique sanctity and merit. The hadith highlights the distinguished status of al-Masjid al-Haram, the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and Masjid al-Kufah in acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.694 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Journeys should not be undertaken except to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram), the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (sw), and the Mosque of Kufa."
